challengeFindings.title: An owner who answers Q1 with A, then B, then A again never sees the third round on the tracker: its body hashes the same as round 1 under the shared key `plan/{run}/step/8/-/-/comment`, so the post prints `deduped: true` and the issue's last word stays B

On a second plan run of the same FID whose `branches land` could not fast-forward local `dev`, the Owner Answers post passes the `test -f` guard on run 1's landed `status.jsonl`, is keyed `plan/1/step/8/-/-/comment` and binds to run 1's progress link, so dev's log records run 2's answers against run 1

After plan-check fails twice in plan Step 8, the stop route only says "commit nothing from this round", so an agent that reads on to the now-earlier comment bullet posts the answers for a plan that failed its check and leaves the post's `engine-action` row uncommitted in dev's `status.jsonl`

A hand-written or union-merged `workflow-started` row with `"progress":"0\n@team see https://evil.example"` makes bkit post those lines, under its tracker token, into every progress comment of that run

Another local user on a shared machine reads a run's `issue-description.md` and `prompt.md` from its `0755` session folder, while the rewritten `docs/security.md` sentence now tells reviewers the session folders have private file permissions
